Editing exported snapshots as framework source

criteria.description: Fresh build and required full-suite observation; indexed authorized tenant document to exact cited Local extractive answer and no-evidence result; bounded async provider and real cancellation/original-session revalidation; existing Handoff and captured/new export closure coherence; independent exact source review and ordinary app UI qualification.
